Introduction

Zinc is built on top of the net/http package from Go's Standard library, providing a compact and intuitive set of API's that enable developers to build server applications that are inherently performant and scalable.


We focus heavily on minimising the amount of code developers must write in order to produce type-safe server applications that can leverage Go's incredibly useful concurrency model, routing capabilities and middleware support.

Key Features

Route Groups

go get github.com/0mjs/zinc

Middleware Support

app.Use(func(c *zinc.Context) {
    // Your middleware logic
    c.Next()
})

Path Parameters

app.Get("/users/:id", func(c *zinc.Context) {
    id := c.Param("id")
    // Handle user retrieval
})
